title: leucanthemum subalpinum
intro: Leucanthemum subalpinum, commonly known as the alpine daisy or mountain daisy, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum subalpinum include calming and sedative effects, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for stress relief and sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
